provenance_amendment.change: Permit an explicit immutable protocol snapshot only after verifying that every completed drive embeds the identical snapshot; model, split, selection gates, and hyperparameters are unchanged.

purpose: Test whether a runtime-observable 16x16 matrix of visible robot-colour evidence improves occlusion correction without replacing the strong tabular correction by default.
population: sensor-gate-admitted measurements from complete reference-controlled drives; terminal controller states excluded

partitioning.fit: train models and produce leave-one-complete-drive-out predictions
partitioning.development: apply models trained on every fit drive and make the one candidate-selection decision
partitioning.audit: remain sealed until the complete selected correction and matched covariance are frozen

base_model.role: safe correction supplied unchanged when the visibility residual is zero
base_model.inputs: camera identity, projected camera-relative geometry, normalized detector-box geometry, and detector confidence

candidate.target: reference position minus raw projected box-bottom measurement, expressed in camera-ray coordinates

visibility_matrix.source: soft blue-target evidence pooled spatially inside the detected box
visibility_matrix.source_crop: recorded 96x96 detector context crop containing a half-box margin on every side

candidate.network: three convolutional visibility layers, a tabular feature branch, two shared fully connected layers, a two-value residual head, and a scalar sigmoid gate
candidate.initialization: zero residual head, so the untrained candidate equals the box MLP exactly
candidate.loss: tail-stratum-balanced smooth L1 with beta 0.02 m plus a small applied-residual penalty
candidate.optimizer: AdamW, learning rate 0.0008, weight decay 0.0001, cosine schedule, 80 fixed epochs

controls.image_information: shuffle 16x16 visibility matrices within camera on development while retaining each row's box features and box-MLP correction

visibility_stressed_subset: lowest visibility-score quartile within the scored partition; the score is the mean of total and lower-quarter matrix evidence and uses no correction target or error
selection_gates: complete-drive development MSE improves over the box MLP by more than one paired standard error
visibility-stressed development p90 improves over the box MLP
the count above 1 m does not increase
the real visibility matrix beats the within-camera shuffled control
failure_rule: If any selection gate fails, retain box_mlp and describe the visibility residual as a negative development ablation.
post_selection_requirements: fit a fresh matched covariance from the visibility-residual whole-drive out-of-fold residuals if it is selected
implement the exact feature and checkpoint contract in the runtime camera manager
verify offline and runtime predictions agree on recorded crops
measure the complete five-camera detector-plus-visibility-residual p95 wall time and require it to stay within the 200 ms simulated-camera cycle budget

capture_policy.reason: The stored context crop plus bbox and image geometry reconstruct the 16x16 runtime feature; full frames are unnecessary for this candidate.
